newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Thursday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
The central bank does not post volumes.
Traders said trading was dull today with state banks being net lenders.
Short-term financial centres, money brokerages run by the central bank, were net borrowers with their demand rising due to the surging domestic A share markets, they said.
"The centres in Guangdong, Shenzhen and Hainan were the major borrowers," one local trader said.
Traders expect the market rates to move in a narrow range in the short term on a lack of major market-moving news.
